verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Gusto feature for exporting all account data in open formats or for leaving the platform. The only related items are an Embedded Payroll API with an OpenAPI spec, which is a developer building block, and a General Ledger report returned as JSON, which is a narrow accounting report rather than a full data export. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
